svg.title: What sharing two cards buys
svg.desc: In panel a, the share of the consolidated card's replies over their round's SLO, the 3 rounds pooled, by its agent sessions beside both calls, against the requirement of at most 5%: at 2, 4, 8, 12 and 24 sessions, 2.3%, 10.2%, 39.0%, 53.7% and 92.1% on tuned vLLM and 1.1%, 2.8%, 17.5%, 18.6% and 20.9% on the configuration to deploy; in panel b, each arrangement's agents' tokens a second over the calls' first 240 s summed over both cards, at the median of the 3 rounds, against 9,471, 20% over the best dedicated arrangement: dedicated roles, best practical, 0 + 14 sessions: 7,893; dedicated roles, controlled, 0 + 12 sessions: 6,302; consolidation on tuned vLLM, 2 + 14 sessions: 10,051; consolidation on the configuration to deploy, 4 + 14 sessions: 10,596; consolidation on the configuration to deploy with a warm spare, 4 + 12 sessions: 9,652; consolidation on the configuration to deploy, 8 + 14 sessions: 13,537, missing the requirement; pooling on tuned vLLM, 12 + 12 sessions: 13,188, missing the requirement; pooling on the configuration to deploy, 12 + 12 sessions: 12,111, missing the requirement.
svg.text: Tokens/s over the calls' first 240 s
